queries.name: Overview counts
queries.description: Total nodes per label and relationships per type — powers the stats cards on the home page.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (n)
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC

queries.name: Text search
queries.description: Prefix search across people, code, incidents, and services. Fully parameterised, no free-form Cypher.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(n.key) CONTAINS toLower($q)
   OR coalesce(toLower(n.name), '') CONTAINS toLower($q)
   OR toLower(n.title) CONTAINS toLower($q)
RETURN n LIMIT 25

queries.name: Engineer profile
queries.description: Repos worked on and incidents resolved for one engineer.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (e:Engineer {login: $login})
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:WORKED_ON]->(r:Repo)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(i:Incident)
RETURN e,
       collect(DISTINCT r.name) AS repos,
       collect(DISTINCT {key: i.key, name: i.name, impact: i.impact}) AS incidents

queries.name: Repo profile
queries.description: Contributors (with contribution counts) and release tags for one repo.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Repo {name: $name})
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Engineer)-[w:WORKED_ON]->(r)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rel:Release)-[:SHIPPED]->(r)
RETURN r,
       collect(DISTINCT {login: c.login, contributions: w.contributions}) AS contributors,
       collect(DISTINCT rel.tagName) AS releases

queries.name: Incidents by impact
queries.description: Recent incidents, optionally filtered by impact severity.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident)
WHERE i.impact = $impact OR $impact = 'all'
RETURN i
ORDER BY i.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 50

queries.name: Chain: what broke, who shipped it, who fixed it
queries.description: Flagship query. For one incident: the releases deployed into the affected service, the pull requests riding those releases, the commits they carried, and the engineers who authored them. Runs inside the incident window (start ± 6h).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {key:$incidentKey})-[:AFFECTED]->(s:Service)<-[:DEPLOYED]-(rel:Release)
MATCH (rel)-[:SHIPPED]->(pr:PullRequest)-[:INCLUDED]->(c:Commit)<-[:AUTHORED]-(e:Engineer)
RETURN i.key AS incident, rel.tagName AS release, pr.number AS pr, e.login AS engineer, c.key AS commit
ORDER BY c.authoredAt LIMIT 20

queries.name: Blast radius
queries.description: Multi-hop proof: release of a repo -> services it deployed to -> incidents affecting those services.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (rel:Release {repo: $repo})-[:DEPLOYED]->(s:Service)<-[:AFFECTED]-(i:Incident)
RETURN rel.tagName AS release,
       collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS services,
       collect(DISTINCT i.key) AS incidents
LIMIT 1

queries.name: Path between engineers
queries.description: Shortest undirected path (max 6 hops) between two engineers across the delivery graph.
queries.cypher:
MATCH p = shortestPath((a:Engineer {login: $from})-[*1..6]-(b:Engineer {login: $to}))
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.login, n.key, n.name)] AS path
